howToInstall.title: How to install the app on your device

whyInstall.title: Why install the app?
whyInstall.description: This app is available as a Progressive Web App (PWA). This means you can install it directly from your browser without using an app store.\nOnce installed, it behaves almost like a native app:

list.1: 🚀 Launch it from your home screen or app menu.
list.2: 🖥️ Open it in its own window, without browser controls.

compatibleBrowser.title: Compatible browsers
compatibleBrowser.description: Installation is currently supported on most Chromium-based browsers, including:
compatibleBrowser.warning: Some browsers, such as Firefox, do not yet support installing Progressive Web Apps on all platforms.

howTo.title: How do I install the app?
howTo.compatibilityCondition: If your browser is compatible, an install button is available below.
howTo.alternativeInstall: You can also open your browser's menu and choose "Install app", "Add to Home Screen", or a similar option depending on your browser.

data.title: Important: your data
data.description: Installing the app does not automatically transfer data already stored in your browser.
data.warning: Each installation has its own storage space. If you install the app on a new device (or after reinstalling your browser), your previous data won't be restored automatically.

needHelp.title: Need help?
needHelp.conditionnalSituation: If the install button doesn't appear:

list.1: make sure you're using a compatible browser;
list.2: check that you're visiting the site over HTTPS;
list.4: make sure the app isn't already installed.

BlockInstallPWA.error: Unfortunately, your browser doesn't support installing this app.\nTry using another browser.
